title: CurvTrust-PAI: Reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual for network intrusion analysis and trust-based safety filtering in multi-agent cyber-physical systems
description:
CurvTrust-PAI evaluates a reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual (absolute deviation of a Jaccard neighbourhood-overlap score from its median over a clean reference set) in two independent settings:

  1. Network-flow intrusion analysis — residual as an auxiliary classifier feature and as a stand-alone conformal detector on UNSW-NB15, NF-ToN-IoT-v2, NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018-v2, CIDDS-001 and Custom-EdgeIoT.
  2. Trust-conditioned safety filtering in a simulated multi-agent swarm — residual combined with identity, kinematic innovation and graph-isolation evidence to set the separation margin of a relative-degree-two barrier filter.

The two modules share the residual implementation but exchange no data at run time. The repository contains the experimental pipeline, extracted tables and figures from the manuscript, and aggregated results JSON. Public datasets are third-party and not redistributed.
